text:
Asha (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — thanks for the great questions. Short version: we're prioritizing hires in infra, runtime, and a few product-market fit pods. Live Q&A here, drop quick questions and we'll answer.

Sam (Platform Eng): Thanks! Can you clarify how many hires are earmarked for eng-infra vs eng-runtime next quarter? Wondering about hiring velocity.

Marcus (VP Eng): Good q. Current plan: ~12 hires for eng-infra, ~8 for runtime, and 6 for product pods. Numbers flexible based on offers. Priority ordering is infra > runtime > product.

Rashmi (SRE): How does this map to oncall rotations? Will new infra hires absorb more pager load?

Marcus (VP Eng): Yes — infra hires will reduce individual pager bursts. We expect ~20% reduction in avg pages/person once hires onboard and a 2-week shadowing ramp.

Jules (People Ops): To add — we're opening roles in Workday this week. Internal mobility first: if you want to apply or discuss lateral moves, DM me. Interview loops standardized to 3 interviews + a hiring manager sync.

Sam (Platform Eng): Nice. Any changes to leveling or IC -> manager career path with the reorg?

Asha (CEO): No level compression planned. We're clarifying manager capacity — expect a short doc next week on expectations for managers and IC growth paths.

Rashmi (SRE): Can we get clarity on which teams are getting headcount vs being asked to reprioritize?

Marcus (VP Eng): Headcount goes to core infra teams and runtime allocator. Some product teams will be asked to defer non-essential work for Q1; PMs will coordinate prioritization with leads.

Jules (People Ops): Timeline: reqs live this week, interviews start mid-next-week, offers targeted by end of quarter. If you've got internal candidates, ping @jules or drop a note here.

dev-bot: Slides & hiring plan deck uploaded: https://redwood.slides/p/ah-2026-hiring-deck :file_folder:

Asha (CEO): Thanks all — we'll keep this thread open for more quick clarifications. If you need 1:1s, book my calendar.

Sam (Platform Eng): :thumbsup: noted, thanks!
